title: Bounded cohomology classes from differential forms
summary: Let $M$ be a complete hyperbolic $n$-manifold, $n\geq 2$. Via integration over geodesic simplices, any closed bounded differential 2-form on $M$ defines a bounded cohomology class in $H^2_b(M)$. It was proved by Barge and Ghys (for $n=2$) and by Battista et al. (for $n>2$) that, if $M$ is closed, then this procedure defines an injective embedding of the (infinite-dimensional) space of closed differential $2$-forms on $M$ into $H^2_b(M)$.
